title: Pizza Tax
description: Adds 27 pizzas to Minecraft, also 1 calzone.
body:
Adds 27 pizzas, some with special effects. There's also a calzone. And a bell recipe.

Pizzas:
- Cheese Pizza (No Toppings)
- Pepperoni Pizza (All Porkchops)
- Chicken Nugget Pizza (All Chicken)
- Beef Pizza (All Beef)
- Sausage Pizza (All Mutton)
- Meat Lovers Pizza (Combination of Porkchops, Chicken, Beef, and Mutton)
- Rabbit Pizza (Rabbit and Baked Potato or Carrots)
- Seafood Pizza (Cod or Salmon and Dried Kelp)
- Luck Pizza (Rabbit's Foot and Pufferfish)
- Veggie Pizza (Baked Potato, Carrots, or Beetroot)
- Forage Pizza (Mushrooms or Dandelions)
- Bamboo Pizza (Bamboo)
- Pine Apple Pizza (Apples and Ink Sacs)
- Pizza Cookie (Sugar and Cocoa Beans)
- Jammy Pizza (Apples, Melons, Sweet Berries, or Glow Berries)
- Cake Pizza (Cake)
- Golden Pizza (Golden Apples and Golden Carrots)
- Water Pizza (Water Buckets)
- Frozen Pizza (Snowballs or Ice)
- Burnt Pizza (Charcoal)
- Dubious Pizza (Fermented Spider Eyes or Rotten Flesh)
- Slime Pizza (Slime Balls)
- Nether Wart Pizza (Nether Wart)
- Buffalo Pizza (Chicken and Magma Cream)
- Spicy Pizza (Magma Cream)
- Wither Pizza (Wither Roses)
- Chorus Fruit Pizza (Chorus Fruit)
- Calzone (Calzone)
